data.description:
## Description

Create YAML corpus files in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/principles/ covering all required design heuristics and federal UX principles. Update _index.yaml and docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml.

## testing_mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] principles/ directory created with YAML files for: 10 Nielsen usability heuristics (paraphrase, not verbatim), Norman key principles, 10 GOV.UK Government Design Principles (OGL v3), 18F UX Guide core principles (public domain), digital.gov federal requirements (public domain), Inclusive Design Principles (CC-BY, Paciello Group)
- [ ] Each file has: rule_id, prior_art (source URL), precedence, domain: principles, license (OGL-v3 / public-domain / CC-BY-4.0 as appropriate)
- [ ] Summary + Detail tiers populated per entry; no file exceeds 500 lines
- [ ] Nielsen material uses paraphrase (not verbatim) per license considerations
- [ ] Inclusive Design Principles credited to Paciello Group per CC-BY
- [ ] check-corpus-schema passes on all principles/ files
- [ ] ref-query returns >=1 result for query 'design heuristics'
- [ ] _index.yaml updated with all new entries
- [ ] docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml updated with all source entries (GOV.UK, 18F, digital.gov, Inclusive Design Principles, Nielsen/NN Group)
- [ ] All tests in test_corpus_principles.py pass (GREEN)

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: principles/ covers all 6 required sources, Summary+Detail tiers, <=500 lines
- DD2: _index.yaml updated, schema valid
- DD3: ref-query returns results

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/principles/nielsen-heuristics.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/principles/norman-principles.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/principles/govuk-design-principles.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/principles/18f-ux-guide-principles.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/principles/digitalgov-federal-requirements.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/principles/inclusive-design-principles.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/_index.yaml [UPDATE]
- docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml [UPDATE]
